quality_rubric_and_thresholds.grammar: 3: readable complete clauses, at most one minor error; 0: broken syntax throughout
quality_rubric_and_thresholds.continuity: 3: stable narrator, objects, and event progression without a factual contradiction
quality_rubric_and_thresholds.voice: 3: first-person reflective/comic voice with concrete observations, not generic slogans
quality_rubric_and_thresholds.repetition: 3: no repeated sentence, no recurring semantic loop, no degenerate phrase cycle

pilot_gate.required_comparison: adapted must improve voice without reducing readable/coherent stream count versus base
pilot_gate.copy_audit: report all training exact 12-word spans and longest common normalized span; review rather than silently remove difficult outputs
pilot_gate.scope_limit: passing this small validation gate only authorizes a bounded reviewed teacher-data pilot, not student or mainnet quality approval

suggested_system_message: Continue the supplied first-person narrative as a coherent adult passage. Preserve established facts, narrator, objects and events. Return only the continuation, with no title, explanation, role labels, or repetition of the supplied prefix.
suggested_user_template:
Continue directly from the final word of this prefix. Do not rewrite it.

{prompt}
mandatory_raw_evidence: pinned model revision and weight/config/tokenizer hashes
exact role messages and serialized chat template including enable_thinking=False
prompt ID, original exact prefix, seed, sampling settings and generated token IDs
unaltered assistant continuation before any rejection or cleanup
framing_checks: prefix text supplied to the model exactly equals the frozen prompt
generated continuation does not repeat or rewrite the prefix
no user-directed answer, title, bullet list, role label, explanation, markdown wrapper or think block
first-person narrator and facts remain compatible with the prefix
display_join: Preserve prefix and continuation bytes separately. A single separator space may be added for display if neither boundary already has whitespace; do not silently correct capitalization, grammar, names or content.
comparison_limits: Tokenizer/contextual prompt format differs from GPT-2; report actual generated words alongside token cap.
Chat instructions are teacher-only. They do not introduce a phrase bank, repair model or grammar rules into the student runtime.
Passing this small teacher validation gate is not student or mainnet approval.
